servicesPage.intro: We offer a complete set of technological solutions designed to boost the growth and efficiency of businesses worldwide. Explore how we can help you.

accordionServices.title: Cloud Foundations
accordionServices.tagline: A solid start for your cloud journey
accordionServices.whatItIs: A 4-week program that assists in defining cloud governance policies, configuring alerts, and implementing automated mechanisms to prevent violations of control and security rules. It supports the definition of roles and access levels, and builds templates and blueprints for the standardized provisioning of new computing environments. It helps implement logging and auditing mechanisms to identify change authors and compare the current environment against best practices.

ourPerspective.title: OUR PERSPECTIVE
ourPerspective.content: The main mistake is trying to apply the same policies from on-prem environments to new cloud environments. This limits agility and wastes the benefits of the cloud. It's key to ask: How do we maintain control without slowing down innovation? How do we ensure security from day zero? How do we standardize to be more efficient?

ourProcess.title: Team Alignment
ourProcess.description: We define objectives, scope, and success metrics for the program.

ourProcess.title: Implementation and Configuration
ourProcess.description: We deploy a secure Landing Zone with AWS Control Tower and configure the accounts.

ourProcess.title: Defining Limits, Controls, and Alerts
ourProcess.description: We establish security guardrails to prevent unwanted configurations.

ourProcess.title: Compliance Monitoring
ourProcess.description: We implement dashboards to visualize compliance status and audit changes.

accordionServices.title: Migration Services
accordionServices.tagline: Fast, decisive, and secure workload virtualization
accordionServices.whatItIs: We have a team of specialists who assist in the virtualization of workloads quickly, decisively, and securely. With over 700 successful implementations, we focus on understanding your specific needs to offer customized solutions that boost efficiency and scalability, reducing costs and strengthening security.

ourPerspective.title: OUR PERSPECTIVE
ourPerspective.content: We recognize that each migration presents unique challenges, from technical complexity to cultural resistance. We are committed to being a trusted partner, providing not only technical expertise but also the strategic guidance to overcome obstacles and ensure a smooth and successful transition to the cloud.

ourProcess.title: Discovery
ourProcess.description: Exhaustive analysis of the current infrastructure and definition of business objectives for the migration.

ourProcess.title: Planning
ourProcess.description: Design of the target architecture in AWS and development of a detailed migration plan with timelines.

ourProcess.title: Migration
ourProcess.description: Execution of the migration in phases, following AWS best practices to minimize operational impact.

ourProcess.title: Optimization
ourProcess.description: Post-migration, we continuously optimize resources to ensure cost control and maximum performance.

accordionServices.title: DevOps Tools Implementation
accordionServices.tagline: Simplify and automate your software release processes
accordionServices.whatItIs: We provide support in the selection, implementation, and integration of DevOps tools to simplify and automate software release processes. The key benefits are a solid foundation in AWS, the correct connection of CI/CD tools, and team autonomy to manage their development pipelines.

ourPerspective.title: OUR PERSPECTIVE
ourPerspective.content: The main difficulty is not in the tools, but in the teams' lack of experience to integrate them effectively. A conscious selection of tools aligned with the culture and a specialized team for the initial setup, especially in an environment like AWS, drastically accelerate adoption and return on investment.

ourProcess.title: Assessment and Work Plan
ourProcess.description: We evaluate current processes and define a customized tool implementation plan.

ourProcess.title: Proof of Concept and Implementation
ourProcess.description: We conduct a PoC to validate the solution and then proceed with the full implementation and configuration of the pipeline.

ourProcess.title: Guidance and Support
ourProcess.description: We train your team and offer continuous support to ensure autonomy in managing the new tools.

accordionServices.title: Well-Architected Review
accordionServices.tagline: Align your AWS infrastructure with best practices
accordionServices.whatItIs: We conduct a systematic review of your AWS installed base and your team's practices, comparing them against the pillars of the Well-Architected Framework: security, cost, performance, availability, and operational excellence. Our team is officially certified by AWS to perform these reviews.

ourPerspective.title: OUR PERSPECTIVE
ourPerspective.content: Many administrators have trouble replicating on-prem Service Management best practices in the cloud. The lack of a clear industry standard and poor visibility of the real environment hinder continuous improvement. A WAR provides that objective and prioritized roadmap for optimization.

ourProcess.title: Workload Identification
ourProcess.description: We select the most critical workload to review together with you.

ourProcess.title: Information Gathering
ourProcess.description: We conduct interviews and technical analysis against the 5 pillars of the Well-Architected Framework.

ourProcess.title: Prioritization and Remediation
ourProcess.description: We deliver a report with findings and a prioritized action plan to remedy critical points.

ourProcess.title: Validation and Certification
ourProcess.description: We validate the implemented improvements and help you access possible AWS incentives.

services.title: On-Premise and Remote Technical Support
services.executiveDescription: We offer comprehensive 24/7 support for your physical and virtual infrastructure. Our team is prepared to quickly resolve incidents with a 2-4 hour SLA, minimizing downtime and ensuring operational continuity. Based on ITSM Best Practices, we implement ticketing and proactive monitoring solutions that reduce server downtime by up to 80%.

keyFeatures.text: Global coverage with extended business hours

services.title: AWS Migration and Architecture
services.tagline: Transform your business to the cloud
services.executiveDescription: We guide you on your cloud journey with a clear strategy based on the 7 R's of AWS. We design scalable, secure, and cost-efficient architectures. Our clients experience a 51% reduction in operational costs and a 62% increase in IT productivity. We perform seamless migrations.

strategies.name: Rehost
strategies.description: Fast 'Lift & Shift' migrations to exit datacenters quickly.

strategies.name: Replatform
strategies.description: Minimal adjustments to use managed services like RDS or ECS.

strategies.name: Refactor
strategies.description: Modernization with serverless and microservices (Lambda, Fargate).

services.title: DevOps Consulting
services.executiveDescription: We implement a comprehensive DevOps culture to accelerate development cycles from weeks to days. We set up automated CI/CD pipelines, reducing production errors by up to 70%. We use AWS CodePipeline, Jenkins, GitLab CI to automate testing, builds, and deployments.

services.title: Cloud Engineering
services.executiveDescription: We design and implement high-availability (99.99%) cloud-native architectures. We use Infrastructure as Code with Terraform. We apply modern patterns like microservices, serverless, and event-driven architecture, ensuring automatic scalability, resilience, and cost optimization.

services.title: Network Administration (Cisco)
services.executiveDescription: We manage enterprise Cisco infrastructure. From Catalyst switches, ASR routers, to Nexus for datacenters. We implement VLANs, segmentation, QoS, and troubleshooting. We guarantee 99.9% uptime and reduce incidents by 85%.

services.title: Networking and Security (Fortinet)
services.executiveDescription: We implement next-gen Fortinet solutions. FortiGate firewalls, granular security policies, secure VPNs (IPSec), SSL Inspection. We reduce breaches by 94%. We use FortiManager for centralized management.

services.title: Advanced Security and Monitoring
services.executiveDescription: 24/7 monitoring with proactive detection using AWS Security Services. CloudWatch for metrics, Grafana for visual dashboards, GuardDuty for AI/ML. We reduce MTTD by 85% and MTTR by 70%.

services.title: Personalized Attention
services.executiveDescription: Close and personalized service. We assign a technical specialist to your account. Best practice advice, strategic IT planning, continuous support.
